collections.title: Tabular Foundation Models
collections.description: TabPFN、TabICL 及表格上下文学习的论文、实验与教程资源。
collections.content:
## 论文清单

- [0. Accurate Predictions on Small Data with a Tabular Foundation Model (TabPFN v2)](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6)
- [1. A Closer Look at TabPFN v2: Strength, Limitation, and Extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17361)
- [2. TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05564)
- [3. TabDPT: Scaling Tabular Foundation Models on Real Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.18164)
- [4. Retrieval & Fine-Tuning for In-Context Tabular Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.05207)
- [5. TabPFGen - Tabular Data Generation with TabPFN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.05216)
- [6. MotherNet: Fast Training and Inference via Hyper-Network Transformers](https://openreview.net/forum?id=6H4jRWKFc3)
- [7. TuneTables: Context Optimization for Scalable Prior-Data Fitted Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.11137)
- [8. ModernNCA: Modern Neighborhood Components Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.03257)
- [9. CARTE: Pretraining and Transfer for Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.16785)
- [10. Improving TabPFN's Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10254)
- [11. FairPFN: A Tabular Foundation Model for Causal Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07049)
- [12. Do-PFN: In-Context Learning for Causal Effect Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06039)
- [13. When Tabular Foundation Models Meet Strategic Tabular Data: A Prior Alignment Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19662)
- [14. Drift-Resilient TabPFN: In-Context Learning Temporal Distribution Shifts on Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.10634)
- [15. Using Maximal Information Auxiliary Variables to Improve Synthetic Data Generation](https://openreview.net/forum?id=6PkiUAcTWF)
- [16. TabFlex: Scaling Tabular Learning to Millions with Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.05584)
- [17. CausalPFN: Amortized Causal Effect Estimation via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07918)
- [18. Mitigating Label Shift in Tabular In-Context Learning via Test-Time Posterior Adjustment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04363)

## 栏目说明

这份清单覆盖表格基础模型的核心路线：预训练先验、上下文优化、真实数据扩展、生成建模、分布偏移与因果推断。点击论文标题可进入原文页面；右侧资源区收录本人的改进代码、教程和实验数据记录。
